content: Store this medication at room temperature, ensuring it is kept away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom, as the environment may compromise the integrity of the product. Do not dispose of this medication by flushing it down the toilet or pouring it into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. When the product has expired or is no longer needed, ensure it is discarded properly in accordance with local regulations or guidelines. If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call emergency services (911 in the United States). For less severe cases, contact a poison control center without delay. U.S. residents can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. To prevent constipation, incorporate dietary fiber into your meals, maintain adequate hydration by drinking sufficient water, and engage in regular physical activity. This medication should only be used for temporary relief of constipation and not as a long-term solution. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and proceed with your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one.
